sections.title: S1: WARM UP - Jerks
sections.description:
Weightlifting, Warm up 

a. General prep  
4 min Ski (Easy-Moderate tempo)
-Into-
1-2 rounds of:
Banded ATWYEI routine (10 of each)
1 minute Anterior stretch 
30 sec Back Bridge hold

b. Specific prep
10 Alt. Front and Back Strict press (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Push press (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Push Jerk (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Split Jerk (empty barbell)

attachments.title: Strict Press from the back + Strict press from the front
Push Press from the back + Push press from the front
Push Jerks from the back + Push Jerks from the front
Split Jerks from the back + Split Jerks from the front

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH-SPEED (Jerks)
sections.description:
Strength-Speed / "Power" / Weightlifting, Jerks

a. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
3 Split Jerks (65-75% of 1RM = @65%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@75%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

b. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
2 Split Jerks (70-80% of 1RM = @70%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@80%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

c. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
1 Split Jerk (75-85% of 1RM = @75%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@85%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

d. (Optional Speed/Power-Endurance)
5 minute EMOM
6 Touch and Go Push Jerks
Load:
[Elite] 70/48kg │ 155/105lbs
[RX] 61/43kg │ 135/95lbs
[Intermediate] 52/36kg │ 115/80lbs

Progression:
W1: 3 sets of 3 reps, 3 sets of 2 reps, 3 sets of 1 rep + Optional barbell cycling work (Current)
W2: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads.
W3: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads.
W4: Transition week
----------------------------------
Read more about how weightlifting is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: ABSOLUTE STRENGTH (Hinge)
sections.description:
Strength, Posterior Lower-body (Hinge)

a. 6 sets, Going every 3rd minute
Set 1, 4: 7 Deadlifts
Set 2, 5: 5 Deadlifts
Set 3, 6: 3 Deadlifts

*(Optional) Absolute Speed add-on: After each set perform:
Option #1: 3 Seated Broad jumps onto a box.
Option #2: 6 Banded KB swings (24-32/16-24kg + Blue band)
Option #3: 3 Sandbag KB or Slamball overhead tosses for distance (10-24/8-16kg │ 25-54/15-35lbs)

Load: Wave load format. Suggested loads below:
Set 1: 7 reps at 60% of 1RM (@60%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 2: 5 reps at 70% of 1RM (@70%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 3: 3 reps at 80% of 1RM (@80%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 4: 7 reps at 65% of 1RM (@65%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 5: 5 reps at 75% of 1RM (@75%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 6: 3 reps at 85% of 1RM (@85%1RM_DEADLIFT)

Tempo: As aggressive and strong upwards as possible, Controlled descent, No Pause in the bottom.

Deadlift tips: https://www.instagram.com/p/DZ-0wgoRYz2/?hl=en

Progression:
W1: 7-5-3-7-5-3 Deadlifts (current)
W2: 6-4-2-6-4-2 Deadlifts (Heavier than last week)
W3: 5-3-1-5-3-1 Deadlifts (Heavier than last week)
W4: Transition week.
----------------------------------
Read more about how strength is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH ENDURANCE (Lunge/Pull)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance, Unilateral lower body + Posterior Upper-body (Lunge & Pull)

a. 8 sets, Alt. every 90 sec between 1 and 2:
1: 6/6 Deficit Reverse lunges (barbell back rack)
2: 12 Incline Chest supported DB rows

Load: 
(Deficit reverse lunges)
-Approx. 35-45% of 1RM Back squat = @35%1RM_BACKSQ-@45%1RM_BACKSQ 
-It should feel challenging, but you should have 2+ reps in the tank on each leg per set. Adjust load accordingly.

(Incline Chest supported DB rows)
[Elite] 2x22.5/15kg | 2x50/35lbs
[RX] 2x17.5/12.5kg | 2x40/30lbs
[Intermediate] 2x15/10kg | 2x35/25lbs

Tempo: Quality and control is key.

Flow explained: 8 sets alternating is 4 rounds of each exercise in total. Set 1: Def. Reverse lunge, Set 2: Incline rows, Set 3: Def. Reverse lunge, Set 4: Incline rows etc.

Intent: Improve muscle endurance qualities in unilateral lower-body and pulling exercises.
----------------------------------
Read more about how strength is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: (OPTIONAL) STRENGTH ACCESSORY (Strongman)
sections.description:
(Optional) Strength Accessory, Strongman

a. 3-5 sets, Work:Rest 1:1 (“You Go, I Go”)
100ft (30m) Bearhug carry
200ft (60m) Sled Push
300ft (90m) Farmer carry

Load: Pick a challenging weight for each. Below are suggestions for each level:
[Elite]
-Bearhug: 91/68kg | 200/150lbs
-Sled Push: Surface dependent.
-Farmer carry: 2x45/32.5kg | 2x100/70lbs
[RX]
-Bearhug: 68/45kg | 150/100lbs
-Sled Push: Surface dependent.
-Farmer carry: 2x32.5/22.5kg | 2x70/50lbs
[Intermediate]
-Double KB Front rack: 2x24/16kg 
-Sled Push: Surface dependent. 
-Farmer carry: 2x22.5/15kg | 2x50/35lbs

Flow explained:
Complete 100ft, 200ft, 300ft, then rest as long as it took you before starting your next set. Continue in that fashion for all 5 sets.

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING

250m Row
250m Ski
